text.parsed: He didn't even notice our unbreakable thread.

illustration.description: Three generations together by water - grandfather, father, and baby grandson

characters.action: Holding baby up, presenting to grandfather

narrative_elements.final_statement: The thread continues unnoticed but unbroken
narrative_elements.key_phrase: He didn't even notice our unbreakable thread
meaning: The grandson, like his father before, doesn't see the thread
The thread is 'unbreakable' - this is the title's full meaning
The cycle continues: invisible but present

visual_parallel_to_cover.connection: The baby from the cover is now the father holding his own baby

three_generations: Narrator/Grandfather - started the thread in this story
Son/Father - received thread, now passes it on
Grandson/Baby - newest recipient of the thread

title_meaning_revealed.unbreakable: The thread cannot be broken by distance, time, conflict, or even death
title_meaning_revealed.thread: The invisible bond of love between parent and child
title_meaning_revealed.our: Shared across generations - 'our' unbreakable thread belongs to all of them
